description: React hook for subscribing to real-time transaction updates from Supabase, including normalization of transaction data and handling real-time events.

methods.name: normalizeTransaction
methods.description: Normalizes and formats a transaction payload received from Supabase Realtime, providing fallback values for missing fields.

methods.name: useTransactionsRealtime
methods.description: React hook that subscribes to real-time insert events on transactions, manages state for last inserted transaction and notices, and handles subscription lifecycle.
